CEC Recreations · Solaris VII

28 combat enhancement cards, recreated from the recovered art panels (OneDrive archive, upscaled 3×) and the exact printed card text from Warrenborn's archived card pages. Frame, typography and point-badge placement are typeset in the spirit of the 2.0 card design — no complete card scans were ever archived anywhere. Rarity is not shown: it was not captured in the recovery.

23 pts
Advanced Anti-Missile System
Light
Attaches to Defense
Provides Square Advanced Anti-Missile System SE.
SE RULE — Advanced Anti-Missile System (Domination rules insert)
Advanced Anti-Missile System [X] This unit’s controller may cancel this special equipment prior to an opponent’s attack roll. (optional) When this unit or a friendly figure within 6” of this unit is the target of a successful ranged combat attack using the [ballistic] range type, roll one six-sided die. On a result of 3–5, reduce the damage scored against the target by 1, to a minimum of 1. On a result of 6, reduce the damage scored against the target by 2, to a minimum of 0. Apply the effects of this special equipment after applying the effects of all other special equipment and faction abilities.

Fluid Gun - Corrosive
Light
Attaches to Energy
(optional) This unit's maximum range value becomes 8. When this unit succeeds at a ranged combat attack against a single target opposing figure, do not score this unit's damage value against the target. Instead, roll one six-sided die and subtract 2 from the result, to a minimum of 1. Score impact damage instead of this unit's range type against the target equal to the result.
